A '''battle''' took place in the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ithori system]] during the [[Thrawn campaign]].

==Behind the scenes==
This battle makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. The battle is only illustrated on the galactic map of the Thrawn campaign.
